record.paper_title: Some open problems on Banach spaces
record.original_question: Classify and characterize the Banach spaces whose dual spaces are injective Banach lattices, where injective means 1-injective: every positive operator from a closed sublattice of a Banach lattice into the dual space extends to a positive operator on the whole Banach lattice with no increase in norm.

evidence.quote: A real Banach lattice X is said to be λ-injective, if for every Banach lattice Y , closed sublattice Y0 ⊂ Y , and positive operator T0 : Y0 → X there exists a positive extension T : Y → X with kTk ≤ λkT0k.
Problem 4.3. Classify and characterize Banach spaces whose duals are injective Banach lattices.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A real Banach lattice $X$ is called $\lambda$-injective (where $\lambda \geq 1$) if for every real Banach lattice $Y$, every closed vector sublattice $Y_0 \subseteq Y$, and every positive linear operator $T_0 : Y_0 \to X$, there exists a positive linear extension $T : Y \to X$ of $T_0$ satisfying $\|T\| \leq \lambda \|T_0\|$. We say $X$ is an injective Banach lattice when it is $1$-injective.

Problem. Classify and characterize the real Banach spaces $E$ whose dual Banach lattice $E^*$ (equipped with its canonical order) is an injective Banach lattice in the above sense. Provide a geometric/isometric characterization of such preduals analogous to known characterizations of $L_1$-preduals (Lindenstrauss spaces).
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work by Kusraev and collaborators (2020–2021) provides geometric characterizations of preduals of injective Banach lattices via Boolean-valued transfer from the L_1-predual (Lindenstrauss/simplex space) theory, and gives concrete functional representations of injective Banach lattices. While substantial progress has been made, a full classification analogous to the classical L_1-predual case does not appear to be settled, so the problem is best regarded as partially solved.

status_evidence.snippet: Concrete functional description of injective Banach lattices in the spirit of Kakutani–Maharam representation for AL-spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Functional representation results contribute to but do not fully resolve the classification.
